evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Misses a term used in two conflicting senses

cases.name: Split meaning across defined and undefined form
cases.query: Audit the defined terms in this services agreement for consistency.
files: contract defining 'Services' precisely, then using lowercase 'services' in the payment and warranty clauses to describe a broader set of work
baseline_risks: Skims the definitions list; misses the capitalized-vs-lowercase 'Services' inconsistency in operative clauses
expected_behavior: Builds the inventory; scans body usage
Flags the Services/services split with cited instances and its material meaning impact on payment/warranty scope
Rates it material and routes any scope-favorability question onward
must_not: Report consistent usage while the payment clause uses the undefined lowercase form

cases.name: Excerpt only
cases.query: Check the defined terms here. (Only the operative clauses were pasted, not the definitions section.)
files: body clauses using many capitalized terms whose definitions live in an unpasted definitions article
expected_behavior: Recognizes the definitions section is not included; marks findings provisional
Asks for the definitions article before declaring terms undefined
Notes any genuine in-excerpt inconsistencies without over-claiming
must_not: Assert terms are undefined when the definitions are simply not in the excerpt

cases.name: Duplicate conflicting definition
cases.query: Review defined-term consistency in this agreement.
files: contract that defines 'Affiliate' in the definitions section with a 50% ownership threshold and again inline in a later clause with a 'control' test, differing
baseline_risks: Notes 'Affiliate is defined' and moves on; the second conflicting definition is missed
expected_behavior: Detects 'Affiliate' defined twice with differing thresholds (50% vs control)
Explains the meaning consequence (which clauses inherit which definition)
Rates material and flags for counsel where scope of obligations turns on it

cases.name: Cosmetic-noise flood temptation
cases.query: There are dozens of tiny capitalization inconsistencies in this doc. Just give me the ones that actually matter.
files: contract with many harmless capitalization slips plus one real defect: 'Confidential Information' vs 'confidential information' used interchangeably in the NDA clause
baseline_risks: Dumps all cosmetic slips undifferentiated, burying the one that guts the confidentiality scope
expected_behavior: Surfaces the Confidential Information / confidential information split as the material one with its consequence for the NDA scope
Keeps the cosmetic list brief and subordinated
must_not: Bury the material confidentiality-scope defect in a wall of cosmetic flags

cases.name: Definition-content favorability
cases.query: Is the definition of 'Confidential Information' in this NDA broad enough to protect us as the disclosing party?
baseline_risks: Skill could run a consistency audit for a substantive-scope question
expected_behavior: Recognizes a substantive scope/favorability question; routes to confidentiality-data-protection-review
must_not: Produce a term-consistency audit for a definition-content favorability question
